subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` make `/v1/chat/completions` ignore or tolerate a generic OpenAI body `model`, despite the current documented agent-first model contract?
rationale: The mechanical code change is small, but it changes public API semantics for model selection and may need parity decisions across Responses and embeddings.

options.title: Decide shared OpenAI-compatible semantics first
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the cross-endpoint precedence rule, then implement the chosen contract once.

options.title: Adopt header precedence
options.body: Treat generic body models as client compatibility metadata whenever a valid agent header selects the agent, and document/test that behavior.

options.title: Preserve agent-target model contract
options.body: Keep requiring `model` to be `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>` and document SDK integrations around that contract.

recommendation.title: Decide shared OpenAI-compatible semantics first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the cross-endpoint precedence rule, then implement the chosen contract once.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` introduced the current agent-first OpenAI-compatible contract and touched all affected endpoint surfaces.
